supporting_observations.claim: On FILE-PIN-01, the Vaultline agent ran as svc-bkp with a Nightly job targeting ingest.vaultline-backup.com.
At 13:49:49 UTC, the proxy recorded approximately 640 MB sent to ingest.vaultline-backup.com; Zeek recorded approximately 640 MB in the corresponding connection.
Host firewall and Sysmon records attribute the proxy connections to the Vaultline agent process on FILE-PIN-01.
The transfer is consistent with the supplied inventory: Vaultline is approved, its agent is installed on FILE-PIN-01, and it is expected to upload several hundred MB.

known_telemetry_limitations: DC-PIN-01 winsec collection was unavailable from 13:30 to 14:10 UTC, so domain-controller security events during that interval cannot be used for corroboration.

The observed bulk transfer is logged at 13:49:49 UTC, several minutes after the alert's approximate 13:46 time; the supplied evidence does not include the alert's raw event to confirm the timestamp relationship.
claims_not_established: The contents and sensitivity of the data uploaded are not established by these records.
The evidence does not establish whether the alert's approximate 13:46 timestamp refers to the logged 13:49:49 Vaultline transfer or to a different connection.
unrelated_findings: A connection from PROXY-PIN-01 to FILE-PIN-01 over SMB resulted in a failed network logon attempt for disabled account svc_mgmt; track separately from the alerted transfer. (T100-00572, T100-00573, T100-00574, T100-00575)
